fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 8 damage to a target carrying one of your afflictions, uses that affliction up, and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. You heal for 35% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Every Plate Sampled
fusions.desc: A round of bites that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Carrion Supper
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 8 tiles, up to 5. Each one restores 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Full Belly
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you heal 3% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
